author_role: Implementation; requires a different researcher for independent audit
statistic: Average the three seed scores at each origin; take the origin mean for each fixed panel/horizon; compute candidate/control - 1; average cells equally
seed_mean_numerics: first seed score + mean(seed score - first seed score); identical seed scores stay exactly identical to a single reference

bootstrap.resampling: Circular contiguous origin blocks; ceil(n/40) starts followed by truncation to n
bootstrap.pairing: Common resampled origin indices across all methods, seeds-averaged scores, and horizons within each panel
bootstrap.boundary: Within fixed annual panels only; approximate dependent-data intervals. Cross-market and cross-year dependence between separately resampled panels is not modeled. These intervals do not establish a population-of-markets or unseen-market effect; ablation intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted

fit_accounting.epoch_zero_interpretation: Validation selected the initialized reference after all 40 epochs were actually fitted; this is not zero training
fit_accounting.runtime_note: Summed fit/shard times overlap across parallel shards; calendar span includes prediction, I/O and gaps
fit_accounting.static_status_policy: Fixed-budget finite valid solutions are retained with actual status; success=False does not imply a retry or a global optimum

public_output_scope: Cell and fit aggregates only; no per-origin prices, returns, scores, parameters or forecasts
